text: Upgrading to Filament 5 primarily involves meeting new system requirements and running an automated upgrade script. Your application must meet minimum versions of **PHP 8.2+**, **Laravel v11.28+**, **Livewire v4.0+**, and **Tailwind CSS v4.0+** [1]. The upgrade process begins by installing the upgrade tool via Composer: `composer require filament/upgrade:"^5.0" -W --dev` (or `~5.0` for Windows PowerShell) [1]. Next, run `vendor/bin/filament-v5`, which will automatically apply most breaking changes and output further commands specific to your application, typically instructing you to update Filament itself and run `composer update` [1]. If your project contains custom Livewire components, you must also follow the official Livewire upgrade guide for Livewire v4.0+ [1][2]. Additionally, be prepared to temporarily remove or update any third-party plugins that may not yet be compatible with Filament v5 [1]. Beyond integrating Livewire v4, Filament v5 introduces no substantial functional changes compared to v4, meaning the core Filament API remains largely consistent [2][3].
